name.description: The component, named for the domain thing it binds: cart-item-quantity, saved-carts-page.

path.description: A noun folder inside the layer to put it under (feature/<path>/<name>/).

routed.description: A routed page: its own sub-module, lazy loaded from the domain's routes.

route.description: The route path (default: the name without a -page suffix).

slot.description: The provideX() of a slot it fills (its own sub-module, registered in the featureset).

slotDomain.description: The domain declaring the slot (default: this domain).

store.description: Give it a component store beside it.
